rationale: John is building EZswap, a multi-chain NFT and inscription DEX protocol with backing from EOS Network Foundation and other major funds—exactly the kind of Web3 infrastructure play Yiping has invested in and audited as a former CertiK security auditor and IOSG Ventures associate. Yiping's expertise in smart contract security and DeFi applications, combined with his mentorship background, could help strengthen EZswap's security posture and protocol design, while John's live experience shipping a gaming-focused DEX offers practical context for Yiping's blockchain infrastructure thesis.
intro_message: John, meet Yiping Lu — a blockchain researcher and ex-CertiK auditor who's invested in Web3 infrastructure and DeFi; you're both deep in protocol design and could explore how security and auditing fit into EZswap's roadmap.
